title: Term bases arrive in VitraTM
summary: Term bases in VitraTM, a Cmd+K command palette, bring-your-own-script in Translate Video, and folders and Drive files in Playground and the image translator.

items.title: Manage terminology as concepts.
items.body: A **Term bases** tab sits beside Translation memories, with a 19-field concept editor and language and status filters.

items.title: Import and export
items.body: term bases as XLSX, CSV or TBX.

items.title: Attach term bases to memories
items.body: from either the term base or the memory.

items.title: The terminology drawer in editors now covers VitraTM,
Press Cmd+K to search and jump anywhere.
items.body: Search memory translations and term-base concepts, open memories, folders, workflows, files and any page you can reach, and start creating. Results include only what your plan and role allow.

items.title: Bring your own script.
items.body: Upload a TXT or subtitle file beside the video and it runs as one process instead of two.

children.body: An SRT file gets a single speaker and emotion pass.
A TXT script is aligned to the audio afterwards, so no word can land on a moment where it wasn't spoken.
A video uploaded without a script works exactly as before.

items.title: Dubbing is now part of Translate Video,
items.body: instead of a separate process type.

items.title: Folders and Drive files in Playground.

children.body: Pick Drive files for lip-sync, voice cloning and document translation.

items.title: Folders and verification status.
items.body: Image jobs can be filed in folders, and process rows show a verification bar.

items.title: Transcription could save half a transcript.
items.body: A cut-off response now fails instead of saving silently, and overlapping segment boundaries are fixed.

items.title: Subtitle-only runs failed at the last stage.
